title: acilepis sutepensis
intro: Acilepis sutepensis, commonly known as Sutep mountain tea, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used for its medicinal properties and is rich in antioxidants, which can help protect against cell damage and inflammation. The health benefits of Acilepis sutepensis include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
